frequency_consistency.interpretation: kappa is over-determined and consistent; nu is not, and the spread is drift- plus conditioning-limited rather than statistical.

limitations: No record passes the provisional settled-periodic span limits; these are diagnostic transport estimates with drift-dominated systematics, not certified production values.
Cycle-to-cycle ranges under drift are reported instead of a confidence interval.
nu is a difference of nearly equal quantities: (q^2+q'^2)/(q^2-q'^2) = 6-26, so nu is far less constrained than kappa; at 100 s q' > q, which no passive lateral loss can produce.
The mean-profile ambient is fitted, not measured; there is no independent room thermometer.
Channel cross-calibration was not performed; common-mode bias cancels in spatial slopes but not in the absolute mean profile.
The material constants are handbook values, not measurements of this rod.
